name: io.github.Vitalini/ebb-ai
title: ebb-ai
description: Runs non-urgent LLM tasks at the cleanest grid hour before a deadline, via Batch APIs when allowed.

environmentVariables.name: EBB_DEFAULT_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Default grid region, e.g. GB, US-CAL-CISO, DE

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dispatch tasks to Anthropic (sync or Batch API)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dispatch tasks to OpenAI (sync or Batch API)

environmentVariables.name: EBB_EIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: US EIA grid data (CAISO, ERCOT, ISO-NE, PJM), free key

environmentVariables.name: EBB_ENTSOE_SECURITY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: ENTSO-E grid data (EU regions), free token
